name: Best, Better, Blurst
look: Three stacked rows, each with a Winnie the Pooh picture on the left and a blank white box on the right. Top: plain Pooh in his red shirt with a neutral, half-lidded look. Middle: Pooh in a tuxedo and bow tie, smirking smugly. Bottom: Pooh with a goofy, buck-toothed derp grin.
use: Extends Tuxedo Winnie the Pooh with a third, dumber tier. The top box holds the plain way of saying something, the middle box the fancy way, and the bottom box a ridiculous or misspelled version that somehow wins.
slots: the dumb or misspelled version (bottom box)
describe: winnie the pooh normal then fancy in a tuxedo then derpy
three pooh bears plain classy and dumb
tuxedo pooh with a third stupid looking pooh at the bottom
pooh bear getting fancy and then goofy with buck teeth
cartoon bear in three levels from sophisticated to silly
origin: An extended edit of Tuxedo Winnie the Pooh that adds a goofy third tier.
